name: vesta_calibration
description: Hand-scored judge calibration subset for the unified benchmark. The judge's verdict on these fixed (question, model_answer) pairs is compared to the hand verdict via Pearson correlation; a correlation < bench.calibration_min_correlation (0.7) marks the run untrusted.
